source_text: Et subiicite eam et dominamini. Non solum implere terram iubentur, sed et subiicere eam — id est carnem et affectus terrenos subiicere rationi et Verbo Dei, ut homo qui ad imaginem factus est vere principetur in minore mundo sui.
pass_a_gloss: And subdue it and rule. Not only to-fill earth they-are-ordered, but also to-subdue it — that is flesh and affections earthly to-subdue to-reason and to-Word of-God, that human who to image made is truly may-rule in lesser world of-self.
pass_b_english: [[And subdue it and rule >> Bible:Genesis 1:28]]. They are ordered not only to fill the earth but to subdue it — that is, to subject flesh and earthly affections to reason and to God’s Word, so that the human made in the image may truly rule in the lesser world of the self.
